correctness.rationale: Independent implementation from the specified 24 graph edges checked all 4095 nonempty subsets using induced maximum degree ≤1 and recovered exactly 424 admissible faces (12,66,148,142,52,4). Recreated the 12-pivot deterministic matching: exactly 211 matched cover pairs, unique critical singleton 16 and critical 4-vertex face 232. Independent complete 1428-arc Hasse gradient directed sort processed all 424 cells, hence integral Forman S³. Signed Lefschetz fixed-face traces give chi(r)=-1, chi(s)=+1 and identity +1; r,s are explicit D4 automorphisms in actual source, composition determines all eight values. This is a homology orientation character, not an equivariant homotopy classification.
residual_risks: Character computed through fixed faces requires correct orientation convention; checked alternating signs and generator traces, not a whole equivariant homotopy map.

value.rationale: Chvatal is a canonical 12-vertex 4-regular triangle-free four-chromatic graph linked to chromatic bounds through its ordinary independence and neighborhood complexes. Its first higher-independence enlargement is nonpure of dimension five but has integral S³ homotopy. The reversal of the known ordinary reflection orientation character is a genuinely additional equivariant fact, not merely a repeat Betti number or arbitrary graph slice.
residual_risks: Specific finite graph; no general theorem for all triangle-free chromatic-four graphs.
